newsitem.title: UK: New Holland Q1 1997 sales rise 7 percent.
newsitem.headline: New Holland Q1 1997 sales rise 7 percent.

text.p: Agricultural equipment maker New Holland on Wednesday said its first quarter 1997 consolidated sales rose seven percent to $1.491 billion compared to first quarter 1996 figures.
In the first three months of 1997, the number of tractors sold rose by eight percent to 24,223 units while sales of combine harvesters increased by 22 percent.

In November 1996, New Holland was partially spun off from Italy's industrial giant Fiat with its shares quoted on the New York Stock Exchange, while some 69 percent of the group is still retained by Fiat.
